snippet.title: Liu Yin's World-First Exposure PV
snippet.description:
Game Background
In this world, the Wheel of Reincarnation, corrupted by tainted spiritual energy, has manifested as an artificial intelligence (AI). Through advanced technological breakthroughs, it transcends the limits of mortality, merging flesh, soul, and machinery to forge a new lifeform system. However, the remnants of humanity and demon clans reject this practice. The protagonist will explore a world where surviving humans, mechanical AIs, and supernatural beings coexist, unraveling the conflicts and entanglements among factions.

Game Setting
As the final installment of the Liu Yin trilogy, this game expands the series' universe with a Chinese fantasy-cyberpunk aesthetic, completing the overarching lore.

Combat System
The combat emphasizes aggressive offense and defensive counterattacks. Beyond standard actions like blocking and dodging, it deepens the series' exploration-driven mechanics with two martial arts disciplines and one passive skill set to collect and master.

Equipment System
New systems include weapons, soul-infused firearms, and cloak gear. Players acquire gear with unique traits by defeating bosses and exploring environments, significantly enhancing replayability.

Level Design
Levels feature intricate, labyrinthine "box garden" designs that reward exploration and growth. The game includes 8 large distinct environments and multiple smaller zones, each with unique visual styles.

Endings
A branching narrative with multiple endings encourages multiple playthroughs to uncover all outcomes.

Game address link : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3689510/Liuyins_world/

Discord link:  https://discord.gg/RyBk7hkunY
